ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p / Lace Tempest LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362)
ucs.description: Hunts for the IIS worker process w3wp.exe writing .aspx/.ashx files matching the LEMURLOOT naming pattern (human*.aspx and random short-name aspx) into MOVEit Transfer wwwroot directories. This is the exact initial-access → install chain Microsoft (Lace Tempest), Mandiant (FIN11) and CISA AA23-158A pinned to Cl0p during the May–June 2023 mass-exploitation campaign.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime count values(Filesystem.action) as action values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*MOVEitDMZ\\wwwroot*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*MOVEit\\wwwroot*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ashx") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where match(file_name, "(?i)(human|LEMURLOOT)") OR (match(file_name, "(?i)^[a-z0-9]{4,16}\.as(p|h)x$") AND NOT match(file_name, "(?i)^(default|login|logout|error|upload|download|machinekey|web)\.(aspx|ashx)$")) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Cl0p / Lace Tempest — LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362)
let MoveitPaths = dynamic([@"MOVEitDMZ\wwwroot", @"MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot", @"MOVEit\wwwroot"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified", "FileRenamed")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FolderPath has_any (MoveitPaths)
| where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx"
| where FileName has_any ("human", "LEMURLOOT")
    or (FileName matches regex @"(?i)^[a-z0-9]{4,16}\.as(p|h)x$"
        and FileName !in~ ("default.aspx","login.aspx","logout.aspx","error.aspx","upload.aspx","download.aspx","machinekey.aspx","web.aspx"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Cl0p / Lace Tempest — LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362)
let MoveitPaths = dynamic([@"MOVEitDMZ\wwwroot", @"MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot", @"MOVEit\wwwroot"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified", "FileRenamed")
| where ActingProcessName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (MoveitPaths)
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("aspx","ashx")
| where TargetFileName has_any ("human", "LEMURLOOT")
    or (TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^[a-z0-9]{4,16}\.as(p|h)x$"
        and TargetFileName !in~ ("default.aspx","login.aspx","logout.aspx","error.aspx","upload.aspx","download.aspx","machinekey.aspx","web.aspx"))
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath,
          TargetFileSHA256, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 7e2c2a6f-cl0p-lemurloot-moveit
status: stable
description: Detects w3wp.exe writing ASPX/ASHX files matching LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) patterns into MOVEit Transfer wwwroot directories — the install TTP Cl0p / Lace Tempest / FIN11 used during the 2023 MOVEit mass-exploitation campaign.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/06/07/stopping-clop-ransomware-attacks/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2023/06/08
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - detection.threat_hunting
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEitDMZ\wwwroot\'
      - '\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\'
      - '\MOVEit\wwwroot\'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.ashx'
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'human'
      - 'LEMURLOOT'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Progress Software hotfixes that legitimately replace .aspx files — verify via signed-installer telemetry / change ticket.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\W3wp.exe) @TargetFilename:(*MOVEitDMZ\\wwwroot* OR *MOVEit\ Transfer\\wwwroot* OR *MOVEit\\wwwroot*) @TargetFilename:(*human*.aspx OR *human*.ashx OR *LEMURLOOT*.aspx OR *.aspx OR *.ashx) -@TargetFilename:(*\\default.aspx OR *\\login.aspx OR *\\logout.aspx OR *\\error.aspx OR *\\machinekey.aspx OR *\\web.aspx)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:

| NOT TargetFileName=/\\(default|login|logout|error|machinekey|web)\.(aspx|ashx)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p Cleo Harmony / VLTrader / LexiCom MFT autorun exploitation (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956)
ucs.description: Hunts for the Cleo MFT product line (Harmony, VLTrader, LexiCom) or its embedded Java runtime spawning OS-shell / scripting interpreters — the post-exploit step after Cl0p drops a malicious XML into the hosts\\<host>\\autorun directory and chains it into Malichus / Cleopatra loader execution during the Q4 2024 / 2025 campaign claimed by Cl0p on their leak site.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime count values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo\\Harmony\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo\\VLTrader\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo\\LexiCom\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Harmony.exe","VLTrader.exe","LexiCom.exe") OR (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("java.exe","javaw.exe") AND Processes.parent_process="*cleo*")) AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Cl0p — Cleo Harmony / VLTrader / LexiCom autorun exploitation (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956)
let CleoPaths = dynamic([@"\Cleo\Harmony\", @"\Cleo\VLTrader\", @"\Cleo\LexiCom\"]);
let CleoBins  = dynamic(["Harmony.exe","VLTrader.exe","LexiCom.exe"]);
let ShellBins = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (CleoPaths)
    or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (CleoBins)
    or (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("java.exe","javaw.exe")
        and (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("Harmony","VLTrader","LexiCom")
             or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\Cleo\"))
| where FileName in~ (ShellBins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentFile   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentFolder = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildFile    = FileName,
          ChildCmd     = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Cl0p — Cleo Harmony / VLTrader / LexiCom autorun exploitation (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956)
let CleoBins  = dynamic(["Harmony.exe","VLTrader.exe","LexiCom.exe"]);
let ShellBins = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where (ParentProcessName in~ (CleoBins))
    or (ParentProcessName in~ ("java.exe","javaw.exe")
        and ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("Harmony","VLTrader","LexiCom","Cleo","cleo"))
| where ActingProcessName in~ (ShellBins)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          ActingProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by TimeGenerated desc
